name: Helm of Telepathy
summary: A helm that grants telepathy and casts Detect Thoughts or Suggestion once a day each.

stats.effect: While wearing this helm, you have telepathy with a range of 30 feet, and you can cast *{ref:spell/detect-thoughts}* or *{ref:spell/suggestion}* (save DC 13) from the helm. Once either spell is cast from the helm, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.
